correctness.rationale: Three pairwise incident distinct edges of K7 are a three-star or a triangle, so the line-graph face predicate is exactly degree at most two with no triangular cycle. Independent full Boolean-cube replay (python3 replays/5_triangle_free.py; output replays/5_triangle_free.txt) produced 14,430 nonempty faces and a complete acyclic order of 69,762 covers after reversing 7,018 matched covers. The critical cell dimensions and multiplicities are (0:1,4:124,5:269). Signed Morse elimination gives a 124-by-269 boundary with 3,171 nonzero entries and the frozen checksum; 123 integer unit pivots leave zero residual. Hurewicz identifies pi_4 of the four-skeleton with its free degree lattice; the two unimodular basis changes are realized by self-equivalences of wedges of S^4 on the source and target of the attaching map. Thus the cofiber has exactly one S^4 and 146 S^5, proving the integral homotopy claim and torsion-freeness, not merely rank agreement. The independent signed reduced Lefschetz census on all 15 cycle classes gives the difference of the two homology characters. If the one-dimensional degree-four line were sign, the inferred degree-five character would have trivial multiplicity -1; hence it is trivial. Exact character inner products give multiplicities 1,1,2,1,1 for (5,1,1), (4,2,1), (4,1,1,1), (3,3,1), (3,2,1,1), and zero for all other partitions. The representation assertion is rational and does not determine an integral S7-lattice or an equivariant homotopy type.
